title: Read-only SQLite open cannot recover a hot WAL
body: Opening a WAL-mode SQLite database with a read-only connection fails with "unable to open database file" while another process (the dev server) holds the write connection. Open read-write when inspecting a live app database from a test process.

title: next dev rewrites generated files and breaks stash pops
body: Running next dev regenerates app/next-env.d.ts and appends a nextjs-agent-rules block to app/AGENTS.md. Any git stash taken afterwards can fail to pop silently against those files; restore next-env.d.ts to HEAD and keep the AGENTS.md block committed. Check git stash list after every stash round-trip.
